evidence: Film thickness was measured using cross-sectional scanning electron microscopy (CS-SEM), spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE), and Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS). Film composition was obtained from Auger electron spectroscopy (AES analysis). X-ray diffraction (XRD) was used to determine the crystal structure of the ALD MoN films. Surface roughness was studied by atomic force microscopy (AFM). Sheet resistance was measured using a four-point probe.
